<h3 class="textImage__subline">SIGG-Trinkflasche</h3>

<h3 class="textImage__subline">Fotoprodukte direkt aus «Fotos» bestellen</h3>
<div class="textImage__headline-wrap">
<h2 class="textImage__headline">Erweiterung für Apple Fotos</h2>
</div>
<div class="textImage__richtext jsText" data-qa="text-image-richtext">
<p>Unter macOS können Sie nun auch direkt aus der "Fotos" App heraus tolle Fotoprodukte von ifolor bestellen. Aus Ihren schönsten Fotomomenten gestalten Sie automatisch einmalige Fotoprodukte – und das per Knopfdruck!  </p>
</div>

    var loadDeferredStyles = function () {
        var addStylesNode = document.getElementById("deferred-styles");
        if (!addStylesNode) return;
        var replacement = document.createElement("div");
        replacement.innerHTML = addStylesNode.textContent;
        document.body.appendChild(replacement);
        addStylesNode.parentElement.removeChild(addStylesNode);
    };
    var raf = requestAnimationFrame || mozRequestAnimationFrame ||
        webkitRequestAnimationFrame || msRequestAnimationFrame;
    if (raf) raf(function () { window.setTimeout(loadDeferredStyles, 0); });
    else window.addEventListener("load", loadDeferredStyles);

            /*do nothing if the browser is too bad (is missing functions below)*/
            var flyBoxMustUseGetComputedStyle = typeof window.getComputedStyle == 'function'; /*if exists*/
            var flyBoxMustUsAddEventListener = typeof window.addEventListener == 'function';
            
            if (flyBoxMustUseGetComputedStyle && flyBoxMustUsAddEventListener)
            {
                const flyMenuSpace = 20; /*space between menu and box*/
            
                /*elements*/
                const flyBoxSmall = document.getElementById('fly-box-small');
                const flyBoxBig = document.getElementById('fly-box-big');
                const flyBoxSmallDotsContainer = document.getElementById('flyboxdots');
                const flyBoxMenu = document.getElementById('fly-box-menu');
                const flyMenuMin = document.getElementById('fly-box-min');
                const flyMenuMax = document.getElementById('fly-box-max');
                const flyMenuHide = document.getElementById('fly-box-hide');
                const flyBite = document.getElementById('fly-box-bite');
                const flyBoxBigUnderButton = document.getElementById('fly-box-big-under-button');
                const flyBoxSmallCallout = document.getElementById('fly-box-callout-small');
                /*collections*/
                const flyBoxSmallDots = document.getElementsByClassName('fly-box-dot-small');
                const flyBoxDotsContainer = document.getElementsByClassName('fly-box-dots-container');
            
                /*copies callout text (from big callout to small callout)*/
                document.getElementById('fly-box-callout-small').innerHTML = document.getElementById('fly-box-callout-big').innerHTML;
                flyBoxBigUnderButton.innerHTML = flyMenuHide.innerHTML;
            
                /*if javascript is enabled, show it*/
                setTimeout(function(){
                 $(flyBoxSmall).fadeIn(2000);
                 $(flyBoxSmall).addClass('loaded');
                }, 5000);
                
            
                /*==================================================================*/
                /*if callout is too big, transform it to make it smaller by %*/
                var flyBoxSmallCalloutWidth = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(flyBoxSmallCallout).width);
            
                var flyBoxCalloutMaximumWidth = 54; /*max width of callout div*/
            
                var flyBoxSmallCalloutScale = flyBoxCalloutMaximumWidth/parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(flyBoxSmallCallout).width); /*how many % is callout wider than it should be? (may be something like 54/70)*/
            
                if (flyBoxSmallCalloutWidth > 54)
                {
 var flyBoxCalloutScale = 'scale(' + flyBoxSmallCalloutScale + ',' + flyBoxSmallCalloutScale + ')';
                    flyBoxSmallCallout.style.transform = flyBoxCalloutScale;
                    flyBoxSmallCallout.style.webkitTransform = flyBoxCalloutScale;
                    flyBoxSmallCallout.style.transformOrigin = '0% 0% 0px';
                    flyBoxSmallCallout.style.webkitTransformOrigin = '0% 0% 0px';
                }
                /*==================================================================*/
            
                var isFlyBoxSmall = 1;
            
                /*checks how far should menu be (position from bottom + height of the box + space*/
                function getFlyMenuHeight (box)
                {
                    return (parseInt(flyBoxSmall.style.bottom) + parseInt(getComputedStyle(box).height) + flyMenuSpace).toString() + 'px';
                }
            
                flyBoxMenu.style.bottom = getFlyMenuHeight(flyBoxSmall);
            
                /*prevention of enlarging fly box, when clicked on menu (if it is clicked, returns 1)*/
                function checkIfTargetIsDotsMenu (e)
                {
                    if (e.target == flyBoxSmallDotsContainer)
                    {
                        return 1;
                    }
            
                    for (var flyBoxTargetingIterator = 0; flyBoxTargetingIterator < flyBoxSmallDots.length; flyBoxTargetingIterator++)
                    {
                        if (e.target == flyBoxSmallDots[flyBoxTargetingIterator])
                        {
                            return 1;
                        }
                    }
            
                    return 0;
                }
                
                function enlargeFlyBox(e)
                {
                    if (!checkIfTargetIsDotsMenu(e)) /*if not clicked on menu, it enlarges small box*/
                    {
                        flyBoxSmall.style.display = 'none';
                        flyBoxBig.style.display = 'block';
                        flyBoxMenu.style.bottom = getFlyMenuHeight(flyBoxBig);
                        flyMenuMax.style.display = 'none';
                        flyMenuMin.style.display = 'block';
                        flyBite.style.right = '22px';
                        isFlyBoxSmall = 0;
                    }
                }
            
                function minimizeFlyBox(e)
                {
                 /*don't show small box on scroll until it's fully shown on loading (delay 5s and fadein 2s)*/
                 if ($(flyBoxSmall).hasClass('loaded')) {
                     flyBoxSmall.style.display = 'block';
                     flyBoxBig.style.display = 'none';
                     flyBoxMenu.style.bottom = getFlyMenuHeight(flyBoxSmall);
                     flyMenuMax.style.display = 'block';
                     flyMenuMin.style.display = 'none';
                     flyBite.style.right = '12px';
                     isFlyBoxSmall = 1;
                 }
                }
            
                function flydotsmenu()
                {
                    if (flyBoxMenu.style.display == 'none')
                    {
                        flyBoxMenu.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        flyBoxMenu.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }
            
                function flyNoDisplay ()
                {
                 flyBoxSmall.style.display = 'none';
                    flyBoxBig.style.display = 'none';
                    flyBoxMenu.style.display = 'none';
                    $(flyBoxSmall).removeClass('loaded');
                }
            
                flyMenuHide.addEventListener('click', flyNoDisplay);
                flyBoxBigUnderButton.addEventListener('click', flyNoDisplay);
                flyMenuMax.addEventListener('click', enlargeFlyBox);
                flyMenuMin.addEventListener('click', minimizeFlyBox);
                flyBoxSmall.addEventListener("click", enlargeFlyBox);
                window.addEventListener("scroll", minimizeFlyBox);
            
                for (var flyIterator = 0; flyIterator < 2; flyIterator++)
                {
                    flyBoxDotsContainer[flyIterator].addEventListener("click", flydotsmenu)
                };
            
                /*==============================================================================================================================*/
                function setFlyBoxFromBottom(n)
                {
                    flyBoxSmall.style.bottom = n.toString() + '150px';
                    flyBoxBig.style.bottom = n.toString() + '150px';
                    if (isFlyBoxSmall)
                    {
                        flyBoxMenu.style.bottom = getFlyMenuHeight(flyBoxSmall);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        flyBoxMenu.style.bottom = getFlyMenuHeight(flyBoxBig);
                    }
                }
            
                /*Sets indentation from bottom in pixels*/
                setFlyBoxFromBottom(0);
                /*==============================================================================================================================*/
            }

        </script></div></html>
